data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative) was GBP 3,048.8m. During 2022 there was a net favourable prior-year development of GBP 256.3m (release), largely reflecting movements arising from the P&C UK 2019 & Prior YOA RITC and other estimate adjustments. Reserve setting was affected by elevated economic inflation (leading to increased loss estimates elsewhere), legacy COVID-19 uncertainty (with remaining COVID reserves disclosed), and geopolitical losses arising from the Ukraine conflict; named catastrophe losses in 2022 included the Australian Floods and Hurricane Ian which produced combined net losses (net of reinstatement premiums) disclosed at GBP 91.0m. Motor and Third Party Liability (casualty) portfolios were specifically noted as impacted by the P&C UK RITC. The claims development triangle (gross) is provided and shows development across underwriting years 2013-2022, with the 2019 & prior RITC noted as a distortion to development tables.
raw_causal_phrases: The movements arising from prior year claims include the impact of the P&C UK 2019 & Prior YOA RITC as well as other movements in estimates.

Inflation has always been considered in the assessment of the reserves. However, the current excess level and expected extended duration of inflation required consideration within our reserving process and resulted in increased loss estimates for both our current and prior year business.
The Syndicate was materially impacted by losses associated with the conflict in Ukraine in 2022 (GBP 60.6 million).
A significant number of claims have been settled relating to the COVID-19 pandemic.

At 31 December 2022, the remaining reserves in respect of the Covid claims were GBP 77.2 million (2021: GBP 175.8 million) and the net reserve asset was GBP 8.2 million (2021: net liability GBP 28.6 million).

data.data_quality_notes: Primary figures used: opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding prior year column). Prior year development taken from note 11(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (Insurance liabilities column = gross). The note explicitly states the movements include the P&C UK 2019 & Prior YOA RITC which distorts development - the RITC distortion affects interpretation of the development triangle. Some event-level numbers are reported net of reinstatement premiums (e.g. combined net losses of GBP 91.0m for Australian Floods and Hurricane Ian) rather than gross. Where per-line prior-year movement amounts are not provided, amounts are left null and confidence reduced.
